analyst.summary: Honeywell Automation India is a high-quality, debt-free industrial and building automation business with a strong reputation and a very high promoter stake, benefiting from India's industrial capex cycle. Growth, however, has been modest — high single digits — and profit margins have actually declined over the past two years. The stock trades at a very rich valuation for that growth rate, which is largely a function of its scarce, thinly-traded shares and blue-chip quality rather than acceleration in the underlying numbers.
